meta.title: RFQ to Auction Conversion: not available on plans below Growth
gaps: Identify or sign in to a tenant on a plan below Growth and a tenant on Growth without company IDs.
Verify that RFQ-to-Auction conversion is gated specifically by subscription plan across those two tenants.
Repeat the same conversion flow on both plan tiers and compare refusal or availability.
